guidelines.title: match shopify admin voice
guidelines.rule: Match Shopify admin voice; tone shifts (errors more direct than onboarding tips).
pass_when: App copy matches admin voice; errors are more direct than onboarding tips.
fail_when: Off-admin voice, or the same chipper onboarding tone on errors.

guidelines.title: dont duplicate content
guidelines.rule: Don’t duplicate content (no second page title under the title bar; no extra nav that copies App nav).
pass_when: One page title; no extra nav that copies App nav.
fail_when: A second title under the title bar, or duplicate App nav.

guidelines.title: plain language grade 7
guidelines.rule: Plain language ~US grade 7; no jargon; no idioms; scannable headings/bullets/short sentences.
pass_when: Copy is ~grade 7, jargon- and idiom-free, with scannable headings/bullets/short sentences.
fail_when: Jargon, idioms, or dense unscannable blocks.
guidelines.do_not_claim: `forms.copy.plain_language` as a merge that drops the Polar grade-7 name. Overlap with Forms 54: `forms.copy.plain_language`.

guidelines.title: be consistent no synonyms
guidelines.rule: Be consistent — no synonyms for a key concept/action.
pass_when: A key concept/action uses one term.
fail_when: Synonyms for the same key concept/action.
guidelines.do_not_claim: `actions.copy.consistent_words` as a delete of this Polar-named row. Overlap with Actions 40: `actions.copy.consistent_words`.

guidelines.title: encourage action cta verb
guidelines.rule: Encourage action — CTA starts with a strong verb; active voice; break complicated tasks into steps.
pass_when: CTA starts with a strong verb; active voice; complicated tasks are stepped.
fail_when: Noun-only or weak CTA; passive; complicated task as one blob.
guidelines.do_not_claim: `actions.copy.verbs_for_actions` as a merge that drops Polar’s stepped-tasks half. Overlap with Actions 40: `verbs_for_actions`.

guidelines.title: guide dont prescribe
guidelines.rule: Guide, don’t prescribe — merchant in control; enough info to decide.
pass_when: Copy guides with enough to decide; merchant stays in control.
fail_when: Prescriptive copy that removes the decision, or too little to decide.
guidelines.do_not_claim: NN/g UI-copy / confirmation already-filed verb+noun / no “you can”.

guidelines.title: select 4plus choice list under 4
guidelines.rule: Select for 4+ options; Choice list for <4.
pass_when: Fewer than 4 → choice list; 4+ → select (Polar named cutoffs).
fail_when: Polar surface uses select for <4 or choice list for a long 4+ set as if the Polar cutoff were ignored.
guidelines.do_not_claim: A house number that beats NN/g handful / GOV.UK last-resort / USWDS <7 / M3 6 / Carbon 3. Overlap with Forms 54: `forms.inputs.match_control_and_size`, `dropdown_chooser`, `combo_box`, `offer_choices_not_only_text`.

guidelines.title: default option selected when possible
guidelines.rule: Default option selected whenever possible; “Select” placeholder only if no logical default. Dual-cite with GOV.UK settings vs questions and NN/g always-default-radio via explicit None — not a winner.
pass_when: Settings / when a logical current-or-safe default exists, it is selected. If no logical default, a “Select” placeholder is allowed in addition to a visible label (placeholder is extra, never only label). Questions: do not use this row to force a guessed answer; use explicit None when none is valid.
fail_when: Logical default exists on settings and is unused; or “Select” placeholder is the only label; or a guessed question answer is forced.
guidelines.do_not_claim: Placeholder-as-hint as a new Polar row (skipped). Overlap with Forms 54: `forms.inputs.good_defaults_smart_prefills`.

guidelines.title: labels 1 3 words sentence case i18n
guidelines.rule: Labels 1–3 words, sentence case, no articles/punctuation; independent sentences (not the first half of a sentence finished by the options) — i18n.
pass_when: Label is 1–3 words, sentence case, no articles/punctuation, and a full independent sentence (options don’t complete the label).
fail_when: Long label, Title Case, articles/punctuation, or “Choose your…” finished by the options (breaks i18n).
guidelines.do_not_claim: GOV.UK no-colons / Fluent top-align as this word-count rule. Overlap with Forms 54: beyond LIVE `visible_label` / `label_stays_visible`.

guidelines.title: validate after finished interacting
guidelines.rule: Validate after the merchant finished interacting (not before). Overlap NN/g §7; Polar names it on the component.
pass_when: Validation runs after interaction with the field finishes, not while it is still being completed.
fail_when: Error shown before the merchant finished interacting.
guidelines.do_not_claim: Deleting `forms.errors.inline_after_complete`; this is the Polar-named component row. Overlap with Forms 54: `forms.errors.inline_after_complete` (NN/g §7). Keep the named row; do not re-dump §7.

guidelines.title: long form errors banner plus inline
guidelines.rule: Long/complex form errors: critical banner at top + move focus to it + inline field errors. Dual-cite with GOV.UK error summary.
pass_when: Long/complex form: critical banner at top, focus moves to it, plus inline field errors.
fail_when: Banner only, inline only, or focus not moved to the banner.
guidelines.do_not_claim: A winner vs GOV.UK error summary; dropping either summary/banner or inline (`forms.errors.next_to_field_not_summary_only`). Overlap with Forms 54: `forms.errors.next_to_field_not_summary_only` + `forms.errors.focus_first_error`.

guidelines.title: dont use modals for complex forms
guidelines.rule: Don’t use modals for complex forms or large information; max two bottom actions; tertiary never dismisses.
pass_when: Complex forms / large information are not in a modal; modal has at most two bottom actions; a tertiary action does not dismiss.
fail_when: Complex form or large information in a modal; more than two bottom actions; tertiary dismisses.
guidelines.do_not_claim: NN/g modal 7-list as a merge; `actions.button_groups` “three or four”. Overlap with Actions 40: `button_groups` / confirm.
